method: Independent raw catalog/localization/image registries and parsed display configuration supply expected membership, prices and routes. Fresh Chrome exercises stable built pages, all published destinations, hover/focus/select/touch, keyboard, noJS fallback and responsive accessibility. External requests are observed and aborted, never counted as live Google Maps tests.
limits: Chrome emulation only; SVG small-area hit targets use an equivalent 44px+ select and destination list. Geography is a destination overview, not a navigation/boundary survey.
